one_liner: Monday.com has a broad GraphQL API, a free developer sandbox account with API tokens, OAuth for apps, and an official vendor-hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API tokens are sent in the Authorization header. Apps framework offers OAuth2 scopes, and the hosted MCP uses OAuth 2.1. The draft's claim that webhooks are signed with JWT is not confirmed by the pages (they only say 'signed and verifiable'), so I dropped it.
access_notes: A free developer/sandbox account is available, and API tokens are managed in its Developer Center. The draft's claims about 200 calls/day on the Free plan and API access on all plans came from a page not provided, so they are unverified. Developer accounts are for development and testing only.
blocker_notes: No blocker found. Developer accounts are capped (1,000 items per product, 10 seats), and more capacity needs a request form.
